ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.8:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a large, central amorphous white patch; right lobe exhibits a high-contrast vertical banding pattern with alternating longitudinal white and dark streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with small-scale pixel amplitude variations (5-15 pixels) along the continuous trailing boundary; includes one prominent irregular jagged excision on the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the trailing edge boundaries of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white cluster of circular formations (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe; sparse circular white spots scattered on the black proximal region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent, near-parallel vertical dark lines (rake marks) concentrated on the right lobe's ventral surface; multiple unaligned, fine dark linear disruptions intersecting the white patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large barnacle colony protrusion on the right distal tip; irregular traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive longitudinal striation pattern spanning the right fluke lobe, creating a high-contrast 'piano-key' visual effect.
